comments.author: @RATheBlueWolf2021
comments.text: I've been obsessed with being successful with applause, but when I stop envying, I am grateful because I am God's child that he says, "You are MINE, and I love you!"

comments.author: @win.elnasinSoad25
comments.text: I tend to compare what I have achieved in life to my college classmates. That is why 3 years ago, I deactivated my socials. I cut ties with some of my friends, yes I know that was too much, but it gives me peace. Now, I have accepted who I have become and what I have. As long as I have peace and God is with me I am more than okay. 🙏

comments.author: @mariacorazonperez4934
comments.text: Comparing w batch mates, well off and happy, but i know we have each own unique journey,and god is present to all of us…. Became at peace..

comments.author: @marie-f1p5q
comments.text: Lately, Ive been procrastinating a lot and Ive been thinking about how other people my age or even younger than me are already more successful. Sometimes, I think I’m really dumb yet I still procrastinate a lot and I end up feeling really discouraged.

comments.author: @GODislove777trustGOD
comments.text: Thank you for this Brother Bo! God bless.

comments.author: @lyaa7685
comments.text:
As a 30 year old, I've been competing with people who seems to me has it all by this age - relationships, marriage, family, house, better career. I feel left out.

I know God loves them as He does me equally and nobody is better than each other but we're all just going about our lives. So if I stop comparing, I feel like I'll have peace in my heart and mind so I need to stop.
